source_text.slice: REQ-519 slice 2e-b (GH #2535): IdP sync no-widening in an on tenant (grant.sync_suppressed, binding.pending_scope), typed sync report, scope_delta on group_member.*, BindingWriters.membership_rows/0. Tests only; nothing under lib/ or priv/ was changed; nothing committed.

task.description: Write the test spec and test code for REQ-519 slice 2e-b (design r2a section 1 2e-b rows, T-S1..T-S17, T-D1..T-D5, T-A3/T-A4, mutants assigned to 2e-b), ACs 2, 3, 4, the 2e-b half of 7 and AC 1(f) membership rows, the SEC step-11 merge conditions and the REVIEWER step-12 notes (F-3b, TS-1). Per-file runs only under the shared mixlock; no mix letflow.check.test, no full or multi-partition suite; mutants applied in memory only.

result.summary: 83 tests in 3 new files plus 2 added to an existing file, ALL GREEN, run per file, one mix at a time under the mixlock (MIX_ENV=test): sync_scope_guard 40, membership_scope_delta 19, binding_writers_membership_rows 20, enforced_audit_actions 4 (2 new). The existing neighbours identity_gh2547_audit_test (18, with the two forced scope_delta edits) and scope_grants_route_walk_test (9, exports pin) also pass. mix format --check-formatted is clean on every new file. 32 mutants measured in memory: 32 killed, 0 survive. NOT RUN by instruction: mix letflow.check.test, full or multi-partition suites (the warnings-as-errors dead-default check of that task was therefore not run; by inspection no helper added in this step has a default argument, and the per-file runs printed no compiler warning). No implementation bug found.

mutants.summary: 32 mutants: 32 killed, 0 survive. The C-3 ordering mutants MU-49 (roles read before lock A) and MU-W2 (mode read before lock A) are killed by tests that hold lock A for real and queue the writers behind it.
mutants.not_measured: on-disk scanners (reachability, completeness, docs/roles.md, guard-source scan) are read from disk, so an in-memory mutant cannot reach them; their liveness is proven by seeded-source tests and by the registry mutants MU-R3..R5. A mutant that turns the non-raising error branch of write_once/6 into success is not killable: Audit.insert_entry/3 cannot return an error tuple for a valid schema name and a normalised trace id (only raise, covered by T-S12).

implementation_findings: NO IMPLEMENTATION BUG FOUND: every test is green against the working tree and every mutant is killed.

OBS-1: a role is bound to exactly one group (tenant_roles.name is globally unique), so a NON-member's held-aware before scope for a role bound to the candidate group is always :deny. 'Already tenant-wide for the role' is therefore reachable only as 'already a member' (T-S5), where the member shortcut applies; the widening test's before-is-tenant-wide branch is exercised by the pure would_widen?/2 test only (MU-14a/14b). Not a defect.

OBS-2: design 8.2 T-S15 words the queue as 'sync queued, rebind queued behind it'; with that order the sync commits first and both a before-lock and an after-lock read give the same result, so it cannot kill MU-49. The test queues the REBIND first and the sync second (the sync has already resolved its candidates when it blocks on lock A) and keeps the other order as a control. Same for the mode (T-S15c).
OBS-3: the design (3.8) says the GH 2547 tests pass unedited; the forced scope_delta edit in test/letflow/routers/identity_gh2547_audit_test.exs (ELIXIR-DEV) is exact-equality and not weakened.
OBS-4: the claim resolver only resolves kind platform_role names, so a routing-role-only group is never a sync candidate; T-S16 pins both that and the ignored routing binding on a mixed group.
OBS-5 (TS-1): sync_role_claims_report/3 returns {:ok, original_user} for a swallowed failure, indistinguishable from nothing to do; T-S12 pins the current behaviour deliberately.
OBS-6 (environment): the scratchpad mut.exs, runmut.sh, runtests.sh and muts/ were written by this step; the mixlock directory is also taken by other sessions (owner file), waited for, never removed.
